title: 1.1 Importance of Physics to Society
description: The influence of physics on society: transport, health, electronics, military, and quality of life

questions.question: According to the textbook, how does physics improve the quality of life?
options: By removing the need for doctors in hospitals
By providing the basic understanding necessary for developing new instrumentation and techniques for medical applications
By replacing all other sciences in schools
questions.correctAnswer: By providing the basic understanding necessary for developing new instrumentation and techniques for medical applications

questions.question: Which of the following is a medical application made possible by physics?
Computer tomography (CT) is a physics-based technique used in which field?
Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is a technique that was developed thanks to physics understanding used for what purpose?
Which of the following techniques is associated with medical imaging?
Ultrasonic imaging is an example of physics-based instrumentation used for what purpose?
Laser surgery became possible because physics provided what?
options: The basic understanding necessary for new medical techniques
questions.correctAnswer: The basic understanding necessary for new medical techniques

questions.question: According to the textbook, which vehicles require the help of physics experts to be constructed?
Space shuttles are constructed with the help of experts in which field?
Which science underpins the entire electronics industry?
Computers, smartphones, TVs, and radios all operate on principles of physics such as which of the following?
The working of everyday electronic devices relies most directly on which of the following?
Physics is useful for military purposes mainly in what way?
Many of the scientists responsible for inventing the atomic bomb were which of the following?
Today, physicists are involved in the creation of which of the following?
How does physics contribute to economic development?
options: By encouraging people to live in rural areas
By enabling new technologies that boost a country's economy and industry
By increasing the number of public holidays
By reducing the need for education
questions.correctAnswer: By enabling new technologies that boost a country's economy and industry

questions.question: Understanding physics enables new technologies that benefit a country's what?

questions.correctAnswer: Physics improves quality of life and drives technology and economic development
